summary: Wave 2 Phase 1 targeted migration/seed governance tests pass, and the Phase 1 implementation aligns with the current-phase seed/deploy-gate tasks. Acceptance is rejected because the required closeout test gate exits 1 with an unlisted science-advantage migration-global-setup failure; this is Phase-1-relevant migration-runner evidence and is not one of the supplied known non-blocking failures. The check-types closeout gate also exits 1 from known pre-existing sales/codecamp/science failures.
blocking_findings: Closeout test gate failed: `CI=true pnpm turbo run test --filter=@reading-advantage/db --filter=science-advantage --filter=codecamp-advantage --filter=sales-advantage` exited 1. The first failing package was science-advantage globalSetup before tests ran: `pnpm --filter @reading-advantage/db migrate` against `postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/science_advantage_test` exited 1, so Vitest reported `No test files found` and `Drizzle migrate exited with status 1`. A fresh probe DB using `drizzle-kit migrate` also exited 1 with only `undefined` after `applying migrations...`; this is not included in the orchestrator-supplied known pre-existing list and is directly related to migration governance proof. Larger remediation is needed before Phase 1 can be accepted.
nonblocking_findings: Targeted Phase 1 Red-now-Green command passed: db governance/seed tests 6 files / 98 tests, science grade-4 seed tests 2 files / 21 tests, and sales seed contract 1 file / 3 tests all exited 0.

packages/db aggregate test within the closeout run passed: 34 passed files, 2 skipped files, 641 passed tests, 6 skipped tests; ledger-doctor.test.ts and stale-ledger.test.ts skipped without PG_TEST_URL as allowed by strategy.

The closeout check-types command exited 1 from known pre-existing failures: sales-advantage `lib/trpc.ts` TS2742 (2 errors, owner: sales scaffold/type hygiene), codecamp-advantage `app/api/chat/route.ts` TS2307 for `@reading-advantage/ai` (owner: Wave 2 Phase 2 AI barrel/provider work), and science-advantage OpenTelemetry/Sentry/audit-debt/test typing errors including `instrumentation.ts`, `lib/instrumentation.node.ts`, Zod mock tests, and Sentry config tests (owner: science observability/audit-debt).

codecamp-advantage test package alone exits 1 with pre-existing prod-smoke/live-network and artifact-track failures (40 failed / 961 passed / 64 skipped in the observed run). This matches the Phase 3 test-signal/prod-smoke debt class and was not introduced by Phase 1 seed/migration changes.

Plan truthfulness check passed for current Phase 1 claims: the plan records the corrected CodeCamp Red layer honestly (wrong duplicate-type assertion replaced by seed idempotency) and does not claim the Phase 1 closeout aggregate gates are green.

Marker hygiene for Phase 1 is acceptable: all five Phase 1 tasks are marked `[x]`; no `[ ]`, `[~]`, or `[b] deferred:<owner>` remains in the current phase. Future phases remain pending and are not claimed complete.

A1 supervisor check passed by source review: `measure/automation-supervisor.py` uses task regex `[~xb]`, has `is_task_structurally_blocked`, recognizes status `b`, and recognizes structured `deferred:<owner>` rather than free-text deferred substrings.

A3/A4 checks passed for new Phase 1 tests: seed/migration assertions use labeled counts (`Missing sentinel count`, `Required migration behind count`, `Invalid grade-4 seed item count`, `Orphan lesson count`, `Draft-visible lesson count`, `Wrongly-skipped canonical lesson count`) and fixture-count guards prevent vacuous seed-suite passes.

A6/A7 checks found no Wave 2 registry overstatement or over-broad banned-term filters in the searched scopes. A9 is clean for changed Phase 1 tests; pre-existing CodeCamp prod-smoke archive/path debt remains out of current-phase scope and is part of the known prod-smoke/test-signal debt class.
